scope: Controlled initial local asset readiness, runtime-unloaded provider Open, and metadata attributes under planned writer load. No live Plex or YouTube qualification.

linux.network: none except controlled container loopback HTTP
linux.fuse: mounted workloads use the quality gate FUSE exception

environment.execution: sequential version and workload runs; no quality gate or other profiling workload in parallel

scan.observation: Drain the earlier discovery scan notification. Count local manifest entries when prepareRecording returns and its prepared-recording scan request exists. Poll asset completion at 1 ms intervals. Each sample uses a new catalogue, channel, cache, and worker.

cold.unloaded: runtime representation and metadata maps cleared between opens; durable catalogue, indexes, descriptor, and payload cache retained
cold.timed: provider.Open only; runtime reset and inode comparison excluded
cold.counts: resolver calls, source HTTP requests, and atomic index/descriptor replacements

writes.membership: uploads plus one selected playlist sharing all videos
writes.latency: service and planned-arrival-to-completion measured separately; overdue arrivals are retained; all reads and writes must finish
writes.summary: Median and range of ten independent per-sample percentiles; not a pooled percentile. ns/op is the entire fixed workload window, not per-request latency.

updates.timed: one canonical timestamp increment including projection maintenance; no concurrent readers

statistics.p_notation: p=0.000 is rounded and means p<0.001; equal zero-valued counters have no meaningful geometric ratio.

limits: Container tmpfs results do not establish native Linux SSD latency.
Cold provider Open does not measure payload reads, actual source resolver latency, or first frame.
Initial asset readiness is best effort, not a barrier against an already running scan or a guaranteed Plex asset import.
Slow initial asset attempts can add two canceled request attempts before a background retry.
Allocated bytes and allocation counts are retained; total resident memory and driver/page-cache memory were not measured.
Read-pool connections and statement retention are bounded; changed-file publication still syncs and source identity/range verification is preserved.

inputs.scope: Final paired scan, Linux cold Open, and native cold Open runs; files unchanged throughout.

media_hash_scope: Exact hashes checked across the final paired media confirmation. The original series used fixed generation commands but did not capture per-run media hashes. Original samples remain retained separately.
